## Valencia Furnished Rental Shortlist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

- **2 listings** meet every hard constraint: **Benimaclet Bright Flat** and **Algirós Terrace**.
- Ranked by lowest total move-in cost, the best fit is **Benimaclet Bright Flat** at **€2,560 upfront** and **€1,280/month all-in**.
- All six listings allow cats, and all six are within the **35-minute** transit limit to **Universitat Politècnica de València**.

## Constraint Check and Move-In Cost Ranking
Valid matches are shown first, ranked by lowest upfront cost.

| Listing | Monthly total | Move-in cost | Key facts | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| **Benimaclet Bright Flat** | **€1,280** incl. fees | **€2,560** | 2 bed; furnished; cats allowed; agency fee €0; deposit 1 month; lease 12 months; 28 min to UPV | **Match #1** |
| **Algirós Terrace** | **€1,330** incl. fees | **€3,990** | 2 bed; furnished; cats allowed; agency fee €0; deposit 2 months; lease 11 months; 32 min to UPV | **Match #2** |
| Ruzafa Loft | €1,410 incl. fees | €2,750 | 2 bed; furnished; cats allowed; agency fee €0; deposit 1 month; lease 12 months; 31 min to UPV | Fails **monthly cost cap** (€1,410 > €1,350) |
| Campanar Family Apt | €1,250 incl. fees | €3,750 | 3 bed; furnished; cats allowed; agency fee **€1,250**; deposit 1 month; lease 12 months; 34 min to UPV | Fails **no agency fee** rule |
| Patraix Value Flat | €1,180 incl. fees | €2,360 | 2 bed; **semi-furnished**; cats allowed; agency fee €0; deposit 1 month; lease 12 months; 29 min to UPV | Fails **furnished** rule |
| Mestalla Compact | €1,300 incl. fees | €2,600 | **1 bed**; furnished; cats allowed; agency fee €0; deposit 1 month; lease 12 months; 18 min to UPV | Fails **2-bedroom minimum** |

## Best Pick for the 2025-09-01 Move

Option 1: **Benimaclet Bright Flat** | Best overall and lowest upfront cost among valid matches | **€1,280/month all-in; €2,560 move-in**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Meets every hard constraint cleanly.
- Lowest move-in cost of the qualifying listings.
- Also beats the other valid option on monthly cost and transit time.

Option 2: **Algirós Terrace** | Valid alternative if the terrace matters enough to justify the deposit | **€1,330/month all-in; €3,990 move-in**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Meets every hard constraint.
- Costs **€1,430 more upfront** than Benimaclet because of the **2-month deposit**.
- Slightly higher monthly cost and slightly longer commute.

## Cost Calculation Basis
- **Move-in cost = first month’s total monthly payment + deposit + any agency fee.**
- Where fees were split out separately, the deposit was treated as based on the listed **rent** amount; where fees were already included, the deposit was treated as one month of the advertised monthly figure.
- No pet deposit, utilities, or extra admin charges were listed, so they were **not** added.

## Best Double Feature for a Fun-but-Smart Night
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/ticket-perforated.svg

- **Best pair:** **Knives Out** + **Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse**
- **Watch order:** **Knives Out** → **20-minute break** → **Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse**
- **Total time:** **268 minutes (4h 28m)**, which is **17 minutes under** your 4h 45m limit
- **Why this wins:** It gives you the strongest mix of clever mystery, upbeat energy, English-language accessibility, and low-gore crowd appeal without tipping into heavy romance or emotionally draining territory.
- **Why this order works:** Start with the denser, clue-heavy whodunit while everyone is fresh, then end with the most kinetic, colorful, feel-good movie of the shortlist.

## Movie-by-Movie Fit Check
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

| Film | Runtime | Language | Constraint Fit | Vibe Match | Verdict |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Knives Out | 131 min | English | Low violence; light emotional weight | Witty, clever mystery-comedy | **Pick** |
| The Martian | 144 min | English | Low violence; uplifting | Smart, optimistic sci-fi | Strong alternate |
| Arrival | 116 min | English | Low violence; more serious tone | Smart but subdued | Not chosen |
| Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse | 117 min | English | Stylized violence; upbeat | Inventive, energetic, very fun | **Pick** |
| Palm Springs | 90 min | English | Low violence; romance more central | Playful, lighter-weight cleverness | Not chosen |
| Train to Busan | 118 min | Korean | High violence; subtitles; intense | Too stressful/gory for brief | Not chosen |
| Game Night | 100 min | English | Mild violence; easy watch | Funny, chaotic mystery-comedy | Good backup |

## Why the Other Five Didn’t Make the Cut
- **The Martian** — It is the best backup, but its 144-minute runtime blocks the ideal pairing with Knives Out and loses to the tighter, more varied winner.
- **Arrival** — It is intelligent and excellent, but its thoughtful, serious mood is less upbeat than the “fun but smart” tone you want.
- **Palm Springs** — It is breezy and entertaining, but the romance angle is more central than your group seems to want tonight.
- **Train to Busan** — It misses on three constraints at once: subtitles, high gore, and a much more intense emotional experience.
- **Game Night** — It is a solid fallback, but it leans broader and more chaotic than clever compared with the two selected films.

## Snack Ideas That Match the Vibe
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

- **Truffle black-pepper popcorn** — feels a little sharp and upscale, which fits the Knives Out half of the night.
- **Mini sliders or bao buns** — satisfying enough for the break without becoming a heavy dinner situation.
- **Dark chocolate + sour citrus gummies** — a smart mix of sleek and playful, which matches the double feature perfectly.

## Best Match for Your Flights and Work Calls
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/airplane.svg

- I ranked these for **comfort over 6+ hours → mic quality → ANC → sound**, with **$320 max** and **Bluetooth multipoint for iPhone + Windows** treated as must-haves.
- For your device mix, **reliable multipoint matters more than codec differences**.
- **Best overall:** Bose QuietComfort 2023
- **Best value:** Soundcore Space One Pro

## Ranked Headphone Comparison
| Rank | Model | Price | Comfort | Mic | ANC | Sound | Weight / Battery | Multipoint | Fit for your use |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bose QuietComfort 2023 | $299 | 9/10 | 8/10 | 9/10 | 8/10 | 240g / 24h ANC | Yes | Best all-around for long wear, calls, and travel |
| 2 | Sony WH-1000XM4 | $279 | 8/10 | 7/10 | 9/10 | 8/10 | 254g / 30h ANC | Yes | Strong runner-up with better battery |
| 3 | Soundcore Space One Pro | $199 | 8/10 | 7/10 | 7/10 | 7/10 | 290g / 40h ANC | Yes | Best savings without missing key features |
| 4 | Sennheiser Accentum Plus | $229 | 8/10 | 6/10 | 7/10 | 8/10 | 227g / 50h ANC | Yes | Great battery, but weaker mic hurts office use |
| 5 | Apple AirPods Max | $479 | 7/10 | 8/10 | 9/10 | 9/10 | 385g / 20h ANC | Limited | Over budget and not ideal for iPhone + Windows |

- **Why Sennheiser falls to #4:** excellent battery and low weight, but the **6/10 mic** is the weakest here, which matters a lot for office calls.
- **Why AirPods Max is last:** it breaks your budget and its cross-platform multipoint behavior is weaker for **iPhone + Windows** use.

## Top 3 Trade-offs
Option 1: **Bose QuietComfort 2023** | Best fit for your exact priorities | Comfort 9/10; Mic 8/10; ANC 9/10
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/laptop.svg
- The strongest combo of **all-day comfort**, **clear call quality**, and **top-tier ANC**.
- Main trade-off: **24h battery** is lower than Sony/Soundcore, but still enough for long-haul travel and office use.

Option 2: **Sony WH-1000XM4** | Best premium alternative | ANC 9/10; 30h battery; Multipoint yes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/airplane.svg
- Very balanced and still excellent for flights.
- Main trade-off: it trails Bose on **comfort** and **mic quality**, which are your top two priorities.

Option 3: **Soundcore Space One Pro** | Best bang for the buck | $199; 40h battery; Multipoint yes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg
- Big savings while still giving you **good comfort**, **usable call quality**, and long battery life.
- Main trade-off: **ANC and overall refinement** are a clear step down from Bose and Sony, and it is the **heaviest** of the in-budget finalists.

## Final Choice for You
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

- **Best overall pick: Bose QuietComfort 2023**
- **Best value pick under your budget: Soundcore Space One Pro**

If I were choosing for your stated priorities, I’d buy the **Bose QuietComfort 2023**. It is the cleanest match for **6+ hour comfort**, **video-call mic quality**, and **strong ANC**, while still fitting your budget and multipoint requirement.

Pick the **Soundcore Space One Pro** instead only if saving about **$100** matters more than getting the last step up in comfort, call quality, and ANC. The **Sony WH-1000XM4** is the middle-ground alternative, but Bose is the better buy for only **$20 more**.

## Best Lisbon Pairing for Your Dates
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/airplane.svg
- **Primary pick:** **F4 + H2** — Air Transat + Alfama Riverside Guesthouse — **CAD 3,200 total**
- **Backup pick:** **F2 + H1** — Iberia + Baixa Garden Hotel — **CAD 2,960 total**
- Totals below use 2 adult round-trip fares, 1 checked bag each, and H2 with its listed 12% tax added.

## Ranked Flight + Hotel Combinations
| Rank | Combination | Arrive LIS 2026-09-15 | Flight notes | Hotel notes | Total (CAD) | Fit / issue |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---:|---|
| 1 | **F4 + H2** | 09:50 | Non-stop; checked bags included; nonrefundable | Alfama; private bathroom; no breakfast; free cancellation; 12-min metro walk | **3,200** | **Best by your stated priority order**; only under-budget nonstop option that arrives before 11:00 |
| 2 | **F2 + H1** | 08:40 | 1 stop in Madrid; 1h35 layover; checked bags included; changes for CAD 120 pp | Baixa; private bathroom; breakfast included; free cancellation; 6-min metro walk | **2,960** | Best overall hotel fit; loses only because flight is not nonstop |
| 3 | F2 + H3 | 08:40 | 1 stop in Madrid; 1h35 layover; checked bags included; changes for CAD 120 pp | Chiado; private bathroom; breakfast included; nonrefundable; 4-min metro walk | 2,860 | Strong value; slightly worse than H1 because no free cancellation |
| 4 | F2 + H2 | 08:40 | 1 stop in Madrid; 1h35 layover; checked bags included; changes for CAD 120 pp | Alfama; private bathroom; no breakfast; free cancellation; 12-min metro walk | 2,840 | Cheapest acceptable combo; misses breakfast and 10-min metro preference |
| 5 | F3 + H3 | 12:15 | 1 stop in Paris; 2h10 layover; checked bags extra; refundable minus CAD 200 pp | Chiado; private bathroom; breakfast included; nonrefundable; 4-min metro walk | 3,180 | Within budget, but **misses your top arrival-before-11:00 preference** |
| 6 | F4 + H3 | 09:50 | Non-stop; checked bags included; nonrefundable | Chiado; private bathroom; breakfast included; nonrefundable; 4-min metro walk | 3,220 | Very good fit, but **over budget by CAD 20** |

## Primary recommendation: Air Transat + Alfama Riverside Guesthouse
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg
- **Flight cost:** 2 × CAD 1,040 = **CAD 2,080**
- **Hotel cost:** CAD 1,000 + 12% tax = **CAD 1,120**
- **Total trip cost:** **CAD 3,200**
- This is my top pick because it is the **only combination that stays within budget, arrives before 11:00, and keeps the flight nonstop**.
- Trade-offs: **no breakfast**, hotel is a **12-minute** walk to metro, and the flight is **nonrefundable**.

## Backup recommendation: Iberia + Baixa Garden Hotel
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Flight cost:** 2 × CAD 860 = **CAD 1,720**
- **Hotel cost:** **CAD 1,240**
- **Total trip cost:** **CAD 2,960**
- This is the best backup because it gives you the **best hotel match overall**: allowed neighborhood, private bathroom, breakfast included, free cancellation, and a **6-minute** walk to metro.
- It also arrives the **earliest** at **08:40** and stays **CAD 240 under budget**.
- The only meaningful downside versus the primary pick is the **1-stop flight**, though the Madrid layover is short and acceptable.

## Constraint checks and ruled-out options
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- **H4 is not acceptable**: it is in **Bairro Alto** instead of Baixa/Chiado/Alfama, and it has a **shared bathroom**.
- **All F1 + eligible hotel combinations are over budget**: F1+H1 = **CAD 3,380**; F1+H2 = **CAD 3,260**; F1+H3 = **CAD 3,280**.
- **All F3 combinations are weaker on your top priority** because F3 lands at **12:15**, after your requested **11:00** cutoff.
- **Closest near-miss:** F4 + H3 would be excellent on comfort and location, but it is **CAD 20 over budget**.
